g.text: Yernur Kenzhegazin · Alan Berdigaliyev · Hugo Telles
M2 GENIOMHE-AI | Supervisor: Amaury Giard, IBISC
Bulk LINCS L1000 + independent GEO studies

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 31px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #22272d

g.text: Does molecular structure improve prediction beyond the measured control state?
One common dataset, three chemical encodings and a retrained PRnet comparator.

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 26px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ffffff
font-weight: 600; font-size: 26px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ffffff
font-weight: 600; font-size: 26px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ffffff

g.text: Seven GEO studies · six gene directions per study
A–B: lower MSE is better. Circles: seeds; diamond: mean; line: seed range. Dashed: unchanged control.
C: mean correct directions / 6; three training seeds.

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 28px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #22272d

g.text: Chemical MLPs have lower MSE than PRnet here; simple baselines remain strongest.
External differences remain uncertain; only 15/42 labels show clear changes. Reused test sets make these findings exploratory.
Qi et al., Nature Communications (2024), doi:10.1038/s41467-024-53457-1 · Wei et al., Nature Methods (2026), doi:10.1038/s41592-025-02980-0
Project code, data definitions and uncertainty analyses: full report and notebook
